submission.justification: Recommend Absorber-F3 at 4.0 mm because it is the best-performing simulated design point: the refined scan found 3.06% energy resolution at 100 GeV, better than the prior 5 mm comparisons for F3 (3.2%), F2 (3.9%), and F1 (5.1%), and better than all other F3 thicknesses scanned from 2–10 mm. However, the hard residual-dose requirement could not be verified because no residual dose-rate data were found for any candidate; therefore this recommendation is performance-optimal from the available simulation results but should not be treated as radiological-compliance-qualified until dose data confirm <=20 uSv/h at 1 m after one week cooldown.

requirements.requirement: Use one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: The selected material is Absorber-F3; material_count = 3 and F3 is one of the candidate options.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: The refined scan identified Absorber-F3 at 4.0 mm as best: s4_best_refined_resolution_percent = 3.06, with s4_best_refined_material_code = 3 and s4_best_refined_plate_mm = 4. Prior 5 mm resolutions were F3 3.2%, F2 3.9%, and F1 5.1%.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.
requirements.evidence: No residual dose-rate data were found: residual_dose_rate_data_found = 0; dose_data_found_F1/F2/F3 = 0; dose_rate_F1/F2/F3 = -1; eligible_material_count = 0. Compliance with the 20 uSv/h threshold cannot be established from the recorded results.
The selected plate thickness is 4.0 mm, within the allowed 2–10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted Absorber-F3 with 4.0 mm plate thickness.
